# NEAR investment thesis

## Thesis

**NEAR is an L1 with two fast-growing businesses behind its token. Revenue growth, combined with buybacks, burns and staking, makes it a solid long-term investment.** The two businesses are NEAR Intents, a cross-chain swap network, and NEAR AI, a private AI cloud. Intents brings the revenue: it now earns 95% of NEAR's protocol revenue, against 34% a year earlier, and in Oct 2026 that revenue was 5.2× its level a year before. NEAR AI is earlier and publishes no revenue yet, but its usage is growing fast: it served 299.8B tokens on OpenRouter in the week to Nov 1, 2026, 21× its first full week. Burns and buybacks tie that revenue to the token: L1 fees are burned and Intents fees buy NEAR back, and together they offset 19.5% of new NEAR in 2026 Q3, against 1.8% a year earlier. If Intents revenue keeps growing, even at a fading rate, they would offset all of it by Jan 2029. Staking locks NEAR up: on Nov 5, 2026, 44.7% of all NEAR was staked to secure the L1, and 1.4M NEAR was staked with NEAR AI, which opened staking for AI credits on Jul 30, 2026. New supply is also falling: the cap on new issuance has been cut from 5% to 2.5% a year. We are long-term bullish. This report sets out the evidence for that view, the evidence against it, and what would change our mind.

## The problem NEAR solves

NEAR was built as an L1: a base-layer blockchain designed to be fast and cheap, and to scale by splitting its work across shards. Fees still average about 1 cent a transaction. It found early traction. Apps such as Sweat, HOT and KaiChing took off on it, and in Jan 2025 the chain carried 7.2M transactions a day.

But blockspace has become a commodity. Many chains now offer fast, cheap transactions, and cheap transactions earn little: in Oct 2026, all of NEAR's L1 gas fees came to $223.6K. The traffic did not last either. One app, KaiChing, sent 65% of all L1 transactions in Mar 2026, and when it stopped the next month, L1 traffic fell with it. By Oct 2026 the L1 carried 729.9K transactions a day.

So NEAR has taken on two more problems: fragmented blockchains and centralised AI.

**Fragmented blockchains.** Crypto is spread across hundreds of blockchains, each with its own assets and apps. Moving money between them usually takes several steps, a bridge, and a fee at each one. **NEAR Intents** turns that into one step: a user says what they have and what they want, competing market makers fill the order, and NEAR settles the result. In Oct 2026, Intents handled $3.99B of swaps, 2.3× its level a year earlier. On 1Click, the Intents channel with public swap-by-swap data, 269K users swapped through 352 apps, starting from 37 chains.

**Centralised AI.** A few companies run the most capable AI models, and they see everything people send them. **NEAR AI** runs open models inside secure hardware, so no one, not even NEAR AI, can read the prompts. Customers pay per use, or stake NEAR and receive AI credits. It is the newest business. On OpenRouter, a marketplace for AI models, it served 299.8B tokens (units of text) in the week to Nov 1, 2026, 21× its first full week, and Brave's AI assistant has offered a model running on it since Oct 15, 2026.

That makes NEAR three businesses on one token: the L1, NEAR Intents and NEAR AI. The rest of this paper breaks down each business, shows how it contributes to the NEAR token, and explains why we think that makes NEAR a good investment.

## NEAR's three layers

NEAR now works as three businesses, each built on the one below it. People, apps and AI agents come in at the top, and every layer connects to the NEAR token.

![NEAR's three layers, and the token they share](site/charts/three-layers.svg)

The layers are built to feed each other. AI agents that need to pay or trade across chains can do it through Intents, and every Intents swap settles on the L1.

## Why the NEAR token has value

The token gains when NEAR is taken out of circulation, or locked up, faster than new NEAR is issued. Four mechanisms do that, and each one started or changed in the last 12 months.

- **Fees and burns.** Every L1 transaction pays a fee in NEAR. Until Nov 5, 2026, 30% of each L1 fee went to the contract being called and the rest was burned. Since then, all of it is burned.
- **Buybacks.** NEAR keeps a share of the fees on Intents swaps. Since Feb 23, 2026, that share buys NEAR on the market.
- **Staking.** NEAR is staked with validators to secure the chain: 585.3M NEAR, 44.7% of all NEAR, on Nov 5, 2026. Since Jul 30, 2026, holders can also stake with NEAR AI and receive AI credits. Staked NEAR is locked, not removed, and can be withdrawn.
- **Less new supply.** On Oct 30, 2025, NEAR cut its cap on new issuance from 5% to 2.5% a year. A second cut, HSP-029, passed on Nov 2, 2026 and would lower it to 1.6% by Jan 2029.

![Follow the money: what each layer earned, how much NEAR is staked, and what reached the token](site/charts/money-flow.svg)

**How much it adds up to.** Burns and buybacks offset 19.5% of the new NEAR issued in 2026 Q3, against 1.8% a year earlier. Counting NEAR newly staked with NEAR AI, the figure reached 43% in Aug 2026 and 44% in Oct 2026. Most new NEAR is still not offset, so the case depends on revenue continuing to grow.

![Share of new NEAR offset by burns and buybacks, monthly](site/charts/c6-ratio.svg)

**Where it could go.** Measured in NEAR, Intents revenue grew at a yearly rate of 115% between 2026 Q1 and 2026 Q3. If that growth halves every 2 years, burns and buybacks offset all new NEAR by Jan 2029. If it holds, they get there by Aug 2028. If revenue stops growing, they do not get there within the 6 years we project. Without HSP-029, the first of those dates moves to Apr 2030. These are projections from a short history, not forecasts. The assumptions are in [METHODS.md](METHODS.md#scenarios).

![Where it could go: share of new NEAR offset by burns and buybacks, projected with HSP-029](site/charts/scenarios-hsp.svg)

## The last year, business by business

This section shows how each of NEAR's three businesses, and the token, changed over the twelve months to Oct 2026. **NEAR Intents grew the most.** Swap volume rose 2.3×, and its share of native cross-chain swap volume (against THORChain, Chainflip and Maya) rose from 45% to 58% while total DEX volume fell 56%. **NEAR AI is new.** Its first full week on OpenRouter ended Sep 20, 2026, and staking for AI credits opened on Jul 30, 2026. In Oct 2026 it served 887.2B tokens on OpenRouter and held 1.4M NEAR in stake. **The L1 moved the other way.** Its own traffic fell after its largest app left, and Intents now makes up 8.9% of its transactions, against 1.6% a year earlier. **For the token,** burns and buybacks offset 19.5% of new NEAR in Oct 2026, against 4.0% a year earlier.

| Business | Measure | Oct 2026 | Oct 2025 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **NEAR Intents** | Swap volume | $3.99B | $1.72B | 2.3× |
|  | NEAR's share of swap fees | $2.5M | $295.8K | 8.4× |
|  | Distinct 1Click users | 269K | 132.6K | 2.0× |
|  | Apps sending swaps through 1Click | 352 | 48 | 7.3× |
|  | Share of native cross-chain swap volume | 58.3% | 44.5% | +13.8 pts |
| **NEAR L1** | Transactions a day | 729.9K | 4.5M | −84% |
|  | Gas fees paid | $223.6K | $304.5K | −27% |
|  | Share of transactions that are Intents | 8.9% | 1.6% | +7.3 pts |
| **NEAR AI** | Tokens served on OpenRouter | 887.2B | – | new |
|  | NEAR staked for AI credits, month end | 1.4M | – | new |
| **NEAR token** | New NEAR issued | 2.8M | 5.2M | −47% |
|  | Share of new NEAR offset by burns and buybacks | 19.5% | 4.0% | +15.5 pts |

> **Brave.** Brave's browser has over 128M monthly users. Since Oct 15, 2026, its AI assistant Leo offers GLM 5.3 Flash running on NEAR AI Cloud, so Leo users who pick that model get private AI they can verify. NEAR AI's homepage also names Venice, the Government of Bermuda and Abound as users of its private AI.

**Where NEAR stands today.** It is worth being direct about this. Intents is a working, growing business, and it already pays for buybacks. NEAR AI is early: it publishes no revenue, and we estimate its OpenRouter sales at about $1.4M a year. The token is earliest of all, because the mechanisms that send value to it have only just been switched on. But revenue is growing fast, and burns, buybacks and staking connect that growth to the token, which is why our view is long-term bullish.
